items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: When you were in New York, you said you signed with William Morris, and they sent your trio out to all these different areas of the country.

ctx.x: He did have a first name, but at this point I really can't remember it. All I remember is the Banjo Bernie.

When you were in New York, you said you signed with William Morris, and they sent your trio out to all these different areas of the country. But did you spend much time in New York? You mentioned going to the Savoy at some point. How about 52nd Street? You were there when 52nd Street was happening, weren't you?
No, I wasn't in New York when 52nd Street... I was living out in California then. But you mentioned... What did you just ask me?
